name: Collection of stories
description: A collection of stories as a book: the cover, title page, copyright and dedication, the contents, each story an element, then acknowledgements and a note on the author.

source.name: The parts of a published collection, as the novel-book layout and the Chicago Manual of Style's front and back matter have them
source.notes: Each story is an element under the collection, its name the title; the acknowledgements are where the stories first appeared. The cover is printed only by a cover output, which is a later piece.
